purpose: Traverse the preserved JANUS Slime ancestry with canonical TOPA Spider relation/attention laws, identify missed cross-lineage mechanisms, derive a fail-closed Ideal Slime contract, and bind it to JANUS_ACTIVATOR_SLIME_MEMORY_R0 without granting memory any truth or execution authority.

spiral_method.relation_semantics: Association/discovery graph only; no edge is proof or causation.

missed_connections_recovered.finding: Pheromone similarity alone is insufficient. Exact deduplicated finalized episodes must remain the stable memory substrate; heuristic similarity only retrieves/ranks them.
missed_connections_recovered.why_missed: Historical Slimes often mixed adaptation trace with evidence identity.
missed_connections_recovered.r0_action: Append-only receipt episodes and structural route statistics; duplicate hash is replay, not new evidence.

missed_connections_recovered.finding: TOPA attention is a volatile inspection priority with replay fatigue; it must never become evidence/confidence or permanent champion authority.
missed_connections_recovered.r0_action: Separate attention_weight from verified_route_score and explicitly mark attention_is_evidence=false.

missed_connections_recovered.finding: The PIPPI small-N Spider=1.0 checkpoint demonstrates that a temporarily strong adviser can monopolize routing before enough calibration exists.
missed_connections_recovered.r0_action: Four-neutral-observation shrinkage plus exploration floor; no route drop and stable tie order.

missed_connections_recovered.finding: Loser-learns, negative checkpoints, resource limits and UNKNOWN states are useful route information only if preserved without rewriting them into success or target falsity.
missed_connections_recovered.r0_action: Separate VERIFIED_FAILURE, VERIFIED_RESOURCE_LIMIT and VERIFIED_UNKNOWN terminals.

missed_connections_recovered.finding: Gross exact-check savings can hide a net-negative learned system when training/calibration cost exceeds downstream savings.
missed_connections_recovered.r0_action: Route resource score uses gross_saved_work-learning_cost_work; empirical superiority requires net-positive holdout evidence.

missed_connections_recovered.finding: Golden arena/champion selection remains useful for candidate competition, but Spider replay-fatigue and anti-monoculture forbid a permanent privileged hypothesis center.
missed_connections_recovered.r0_action: Retain competition/history while allowing attention and route order to migrate.

missed_connections_recovered.finding: The strongest synthesis edge is not a learning trick but the authority boundary: memory may suggest/reorder only after freshness/provenance loading and cannot create truth, permission, dispatch or effect.
missed_connections_recovered.r0_action: Adapter calls the existing Activator route selector first, then reorders that closed set only.

ideal_slime_v1.formula: GOLD_ARENA + LOSER_SHADOWS + EXACT_M2R + PHEROMONE_ROUTING + SPIDER_ATTENTION_FATIGUE + ANTI_MONOCULTURE + TEACHER_STUDENT + QUANTIZED_USEFULNESS + IDLE_CONSOLIDATION + NET_RESOURCE_ACCOUNTING + ACTIVATOR_FIREWALL

goldslime_comparison.superiority_gate: Fingerprint-separated frozen holdouts against Golden/STATIC/adviser baselines; exact correctness preserved; total training/calibration cost charged; negative/regression receipts retained.
